prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results in most tests, though the round 2 sign_in hint was under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path redesign produced the only winning test so far, but evidence for this kind of change is still thin with only 1 test.
finish new_screen made performance worse in its single test, but evidence remains thin with only 1 test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish copy, home new_flow, and home wait_info as each has only been tested once.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Flow Reorder: Move sign-in to take place after pet choice and customization so users build an emotional bond before creating an account. (why: sign_in drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel; letting users pick their pet first increases investment before registration.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage-Based Companion Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring animated companion previews. (why: Adoption sees the biggest funnel drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s), showing that pet selection needs higher visual engagement.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Room Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a mini carousel flow featuring interactive tips and companion backstory tidbits during generation. (why: The home/waiting step takes a mean 2336 seconds with an 81.3% completion rate, indicating users get bored or abandon the app while waiting.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Tip: Provide clear photo formatting guidance on the upload screen to ensure pet rendering succeeds. (why: Support logged 3 tickets specifically about custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Save Protection Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to emphasize that signing in prevents pet data loss. (why: Support received 8 emails (the top issue) about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Notification: Enable desktop notifications when pet loading finishes so users who switch windows know when to return. (why: The extreme mean time of 2336s on waiting indicates users minimize the app and forget it is running.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout Path Choice: Switch the choose_path layout to a side-by-side grid format to clearly contrast preset vs custom pet creation. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between available paths.)
7: [finish, incentive] Companion Unlock Badge Incentive: Add a celebratory badge component to the final screen acknowledging full setup completion. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8%, so rewarding completion encourages immediate desktop launching.)
8: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Progress Visualizer: Display step progress indicators and step counters on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9%) and long completion times; clear progress indicators keep users moving forward.)
